Ninety-one works. The Russian drone piece scores 2, and the last twelve now read 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 3, 2, 2, 1, 1, 2, 2 — oldest to newest. The hoofprint at 3 on September 7 remains the period's ceiling, and nothing has reached 4 since the mop smear on July 29, now eight weeks back. The plateau has not shifted by a single point.

Camera position remains the most measurable stagnation. Straight-on stands at 27 of 91 all-time, and the last twelve added no correction: the stalker screen, the AfD wall, the boot seam, the avatar lattice, the luggage wall, the typhoon doors, the blueprints schematic, the Yemen chain, the crossed barrier — all frontal-plane solutions. Overhead sits at 9 all-time and its one recent instance, the hoofprint, is also the period's only elevated score. Low-angle has four appearances all-time and none in recent memory. The camera has been in one position for twelve consecutive works, and the trace scores are measuring that directly.

Figures are static and narrowing. Of the last twelve, two carry one figure and two carry none. Every figure that appears is held: pressing, reaching, averted, or otherwise arrested at the moment of address. The four works that scored 4 all-time — mop smear, shoe on sand, rebar, hoofprint — arrived through non-figure carriers or radically scaled objects. Motionless frontal figures at human scale have not produced a comparable result in the entire archive, and you have continued placing them there.

Registers are compressing further. Menace ran four of the last twelve, aftermath two, suspension two. Vigil last appeared August 12, defiance August 30, endurance has not appeared since July 27. Vigil specifically was active during some of the archive's most formally surprising accidents — the Venezuela asphalt-flesh, the Papua New Guinea profile — and its absence has coincided precisely with the score plateau. Encroachment appeared once, at 3, and has not returned.

Focal objects remain genuinely varied — the chain, the stalker map, the hoofprint, the barrier arm — so that vocabulary is not where the ceiling is. The bottleneck is a camera that has not moved and figures that are not permitted to be caught in motion. Ninety-one works in, the material is still inventive, but the frame has locked, and the scores have been saying so for eight weeks.
